method: Resident population of each named county or equivalent on July 1, 2025. The map uses 2017 outlines, so later minor boundary adjustments may differ. The eight former Connecticut counties sum the 169 town estimates using the Census crosswalk. Alaska’s former Valdez-Cordova sums its two successor areas, Chugach and Copper River. Every state total reconciles to the published Vintage 2025 estimate.
